title: Bank Statement Transaction and Check Extraction Schema
description: Schema for extracting all transactions and checks from a bank statement, including order, date, check number, check written date, description, amount, debit/credit indicator, page number, and appended payee/memo information for checks.

transactions.title: Transactions and Checks
transactions.description: An array of all transactions and checks listed in the statement, in the order they appear.

global_id.title: Unique Identifier
global_id.description: Numerical unique identifier indicating the order as listed on the statement.

date.title: Transaction Date
date.description: Transaction or check Date in mm/dd/yyyy format.

check_number.title: Check Number
check_number.description: Check number if applicable, otherwise an empty string.

check_written_date.title: Check Written Date
check_written_date.description: Date when the check was written in mm/dd/yyyy format, if applicable, otherwise an empty string.

description.title: Description
description.description: Description of the transaction or check, with payee and memo information appended for checks if applicable. You must resolve this information for all checks.  This is very important.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Amount of the transaction or check in positive value.

y_coord.description: top left location coordinate of the amount.

local_id.title: Unique Identifier
local_id.description: Numerical unique identifier indicating the order as listed on the page.  Reset the counter to 1 at the beginning of each page. When  new page starts the value will reset.

type.title: Debit or Credit
type.description: Indicates whether the transaction is a debit or credit. Use 'debit' or 'credit'.

summary.title: Statement Summary
summary.description: Summary totals and balances from the bank statement.

beginning_balance.title: Beginning Balance
beginning_balance.description: The starting balance at the beginning of the statement period.

ending_balance.title: Ending Balance
ending_balance.description: The ending balance at the end of the statement period.

total_deposits.title: Total Deposits
total_deposits.description: The total amount of all deposits/credits during the statement period.

total_withdrawals.title: Total Withdrawals
total_withdrawals.description: The total amount of all withdrawals/debits during the statement period.

total_credits_count.title: Total Credits Count
total_credits_count.description: The total number of credit transactions.

total_withdrawl_count.title: Total Withdrawals Count
total_withdrawl_count.description: The total number of withdrawal transactions.
